segments.text: At Presidency College Kolkata, he was rusticated for assaulting Professor Oaten for his anti-India comments.
During the mid-1930s, Bose traveled in Europe visiting Indian students and European politicians including Mussolini.
He observed party organization and saw communism and fascism in action.
In 1938, he had become a leader of national stature and agreed to accept the nomination as Congress president.
